blocks.text: A Christmas tree can light up a mall. What gives the season its warmth is what happens around it: families keeping a tradition, friends finding time for dinner, neighbors sharing a celebration. For Filinvest Malls, these connections are the heart of “The Magic of Christmas,” its holiday campaign, which began on Nov. 6, with the annual Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony at Festival Mall Alabang. As the retail business unit of Filinvest Land, Inc., Filinvest Malls brings together destinations that serve different communities.
